is_anopheles.evidence: Study evaluated Anopheles gambiae s.l. (An. coluzzii VK7 strain and An. gambiae Kisumu strain) (page 1, page 7).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Mentions Vgsc 1014F (L995F) and 1575Y (N1570Y) in the text description of the VK7 colony background (page 7), but does not perform genotyping or report marker frequency data.

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: No genotype or allele counts/frequencies are presented in the study.

african_field_population.evidence: Only laboratory-colonized strains (VK7 colonized in 2014 from Burkina Faso and Kisumu colonized in 1975 from Kenya) maintained at LSTM were used (page 7).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical laboratory study assessing mosquito behavior and blood-feeding performance.

sub_country_location.evidence: No field sampling locations are reported; study uses laboratory colonies.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: No field collection window reported as study relies on colonized lab strains.

duplicate_risk.evidence: Laboratory study using established insectary colonies.

supplement.evidence: Supplementary files not required; main text confirms lack of field mosquito genotyping data.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated the impact of pyrethroid-treated bed nets on blood feeding performance and flight behavior of insecticide-susceptible (Kisumu) and resistant (VK7) Anopheles laboratory strains using a modified 'baited box' video assay. The study did not test field-caught mosquito populations or collect extractable resistance marker genotype data.
exclusion_reasons: Does not genotype target insecticide resistance markers.
Does not report extractable genotype data.
Only tests laboratory colonies (VK7 and Kisumu), not African field populations.
